title: pubspec without an SDK constraint
description: pubspec.yaml declares a pubspec that declares no Dart SDK range. The resolver accepts the package on any SDK, so a language change or a removed API surfaces at build time instead of resolution time.
remediation: Declare the SDK constraint the project builds with.
limitation: It matches a pubspec that declares no Dart SDK range in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
